name: 1738-batchdecode-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- an ungated re-upload of the gated meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights and config. bf16, 16.1 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 3000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 225 tokens (stdev 150, clamped 16-1024) and generations on 194 tokens (stdev 120, clamped 16-768). Seed 42. guidellm sends `ignore_eos` alongside `max_tokens`, which this engine version honours, so each request delivers exactly the sampled number of output tokens.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant handling short single-turn prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The sglang server's command line. Flat `key: value` only -- the engine's own reader takes
# the file line by line and SKIPS indented ones, so a nested block drops the key silently.

# NousResearch's re-upload rather than `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`: that repo is gated.
# Same weights and config, and the path still lowercases to something containing "llama-3" and
# "instruct", which is how this engine era picks a chat template.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# Well above anything this workload draws (max 1024 prompt + 768 output), so nothing truncates.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# No prefix reuse: every request pays for its own prefill.
disable-radix-cache: true

random-seed: 42
